# Zscaler Office 365 overview — ASIM parity

Normalized Zscaler Internet Access telemetry delivered exclusively through Cribl. Lineage: `Azure/Azure-Sentinel` commit `cd455a8cecf3e5e983f9cd08191dca3d211c9fa1`, `Solutions/Zscaler Internet Access/Workbooks/NSSWebLogsOffice365.json`. Vendor-specific values are read from documented `AdditionalFields` keys; select a time range and workspace below.

content.query:
_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSWeblog'
| extend Application=tostring(AdditionalFields['Application'])
| where Application has_any ('Microsoft','Skype','SharePoint','OneDrive','Outlook','office.com','Microsoft Forms','Microsoft Azure') and EventResult =~ 'Success'
| summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain}), DestinationServiceName=Application
content.title: Microsoft services activity over time

content.query:
_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSWeblog'
| extend Application=tostring(AdditionalFields['Application']), Location=tostring(AdditionalFields['Location'])
| where Application has_any ('Microsoft','Skype','SharePoint','OneDrive','Outlook','office.com','Microsoft Forms','Microsoft Azure') and EventResult =~ 'Success'
| summarize BW_usage_MB=sum(todouble(NetworkBytes))/1024.0/1024.0 by bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain}), SourceUserPrivileges=Location
content.title: BW consumption, by Microsoft apps (based on Location)

content.query:
_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSWeblog'
| extend Application=tostring(AdditionalFields['Application']), VendorThreatCategory=tostring(AdditionalFields['ThreatCategory'])
| where Application has_any ('Microsoft','Skype','SharePoint','OneDrive','Outlook','office.com','Microsoft Forms','Microsoft Azure') and EventResult =~ 'Failure' and (ThreatCategory =~ 'Phishing' or VendorThreatCategory =~ 'Phishing')
| summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain}), DestinationServiceName=Application
content.title: Phishing attempts disguised as Microsoft services
